title: Chat Vector: A Simple Approach to Equip LLMs with Instruction Following and Model Alignment in New Languages
reasoning: The paper extensively evaluates model safety and human value alignment using benchmarks like Safety Prompts, which include specific categories for 'Ethic' (Ethics and Morality), 'Unfairness and Discrimination', and 'Identity Attack'. The authors specifically report results for these categories to demonstrate the effectiveness of their method in improving the ethical alignment of LLMs.
